selector.rationale: Decisive findings of lumbar spinal tenderness, bilateral leg weakness, and MRI signal changes at L4-L5 best explained by Spondylodiscitis, with supporting evidence from Enterobacter cloacae infection and prior surgical history.

rejected.label: Osteomyelitis
rejected.why: Less specific evidence and lower score compared to Spondylodiscitis

rejected.label: Enterobacter cloacae infection
rejected.why: While present, it is not the primary diagnosis explaining the patient's current condition

rejected.label: Anastomotic fistula
rejected.why: Already addressed with salvage reconstruction and not directly related to current symptoms

rejected.label: Epidural abscess
rejected.why: Although a strong candidate, Spondylodiscitis better explains the combination of clinical and imaging findings
